_comment: Who postings are ranked against. Edit this to match you; the ranking is only as good as it is.
skills / strongSkills must be keys of SKILL_LEXICON in internbot/lexicon.py (unknown ones are
ignored with a warning). strongSkills earn a bonus when a posting asks for them.
preferredFamilies is ordered, best first. resumes lists the résumé variants you actually have:
base, backend, frontend, ai, game, security, devops. A variant not listed falls back to the
closest one you do have, ending at base.
